title: Frontend: Portfolio page (positions, add, delete)
description: Full UI for GET /api/portfolio, POST /api/portfolio/positions, and DELETE /api/portfolio/positions/{id} — the first of the two portfolio-area feature tasks (frontend-portfolio-risk-panel covers GET /api/portfolio/risk separately, since it's visually and conceptually a distinct panel).

checklist.step: features/portfolio/hooks/useAddPosition.ts / useDeletePosition.ts — useMutation, invalidating the portfolio (and risk) query on success.

features/portfolio/components/PositionsTable.tsx built on common/DataTable — ticker, quantity, avg_cost_basis, entry_date, current_price, unrealized_pnl_pct (via common/PercentChange). Handle current_price/unrealized_pnl_pct being null gracefully (API.md notes these are null right after a write, before read-time enrichment).

features/portfolio/components/AddPositionDialog.tsx — form (ticker, quantity, avg_cost_basis, entry_date) with client-side validation, wired to useAddPosition; surface the merge-on-duplicate-ticker behavior (API.md) as an informational message after submit rather than letting it look like a silent no-op.
Delete action on each row opens common/ConfirmDialog before calling useDeletePosition.
pages/PortfolioPage.tsx composes StatCard(s) for equity.cash/positions_value/total, PositionsTable, and the Add Position entry point — stays thin per Frontend.md's page rules.

Component tests (MSW-mocked) for: populated table, empty portfolio (no positions yet), add-position happy path, add-position validation errors, delete-position confirm flow, and each ApiError case from API.md surfaced via common/ErrorState.

decisions.decision: Query key convention: portfolioKeys.all = ['portfolio'], portfolioKeys.risk = ['portfolio', 'risk'] (features/portfolio/hooks/queryKeys.ts). useAddPosition/useDeletePosition invalidate only portfolioKeys.all.
decisions.rationale: TanStack Query's invalidateQueries does prefix matching by default, so invalidating ['portfolio'] also invalidates any ['portfolio', 'risk'] query already in the cache once frontend-portfolio-risk-panel adds usePortfolioRisk. This satisfies the checklist's 'invalidating the portfolio (and risk) query on success' requirement without this task needing to import from a hook that doesn't exist yet, and without the two tasks needing to coordinate on invalidation calls independently (which could silently drift out of sync). Rejected alternative: two unrelated top-level keys invalidated via two explicit invalidateQueries calls, which would require frontend-portfolio-risk-panel to remember to add the second call rather than getting it for free from the key structure.

decisions.decision: AddPositionDialog shows the merge-vs-add informational message as a success view inside the dialog (Alert + a 'Done' button the user must click to close), not a toast/snackbar and not an auto-close.
decisions.rationale: The checklist explicitly calls for surfacing the merge behavior as an informational message 'rather than letting it look like a silent no-op' — a toast risks being missed/auto-dismissed before the user reads it, and Frontend.md §2 says only to add a cross-cutting UI state mechanism (e.g. a global snackbar Context) once a second, unrelated component actually needs it, which isn't the case yet. Keeping the success view local to the dialog (plain useState) needs no new shared state mechanism and guarantees the message is seen before the dialog can be dismissed. Whether the ticker being submitted matches an existing holding (to choose the merge vs. added wording) is determined client-side from the existingTickers prop (the already-fetched portfolio data) purely for copy — the backend remains the sole source of truth for whether a merge actually happened.

decisions.decision: Delete-position and add-position mutation failures are rendered via common/ErrorState (the same component used for the page-level portfolio fetch error), not a separate inline Alert/snackbar treatment.
decisions.rationale: Reuses the one component Frontend.md already designates for rendering an ApiError with a distinct heading/icon per status code, rather than inventing a second, inconsistent error presentation for mutation failures. Rejected alternative: a compact MUI Alert for mutation errors (visually lighter, arguably better suited to a dialog/inline context) — rejected because the checklist explicitly names common/ErrorState as what should surface 'each ApiError case', and a second ad hoc error UI would fragment how errors look across the same page for no clear benefit here.

decisions.decision: Added a shared frontend/tests/renderWithProviders.tsx test helper (ThemeProvider + a fresh per-test QueryClient with retry disabled) and switched the pre-existing src/App.test.tsx to use it, since App now renders PortfolioPage, whose usePortfolio call requires a QueryClientProvider ancestor.
decisions.rationale: Every current/future page that fetches data will need the same QueryClientProvider wrapping in its tests; a single shared helper avoids each page's test file re-deriving its own ad hoc wrapper. Implemented via RTL's `wrapper` render option (rather than manually nesting providers around the passed element) specifically so a test's `rerender(...)` continues to apply the same providers, which manual nesting would silently drop. Test QueryClient uses `retry: false` (vs. the real app's `retry: 1` in main.tsx) purely so a mocked error response resolves to an error state immediately instead of after TanStack Query's retry/backoff delay.
